rules.restricted: Youngest teammate answers alone. No help!
rules.kids: Youngest player on each team only
rules.confer: Teams may confer, but the youngest says the answer

clues.q: Before he was a prince of Archenland, this boy lived with a fisherman.
Before becoming Narnia's first king, Frank drove one of these in London.
Before she was a queen, Aravis was this kind of Calormene noblewoman.
Before he was king, Caspian was secretly taught the history of Old Narnia by this tutor.
Before he was king, Rilian spent ten years under the witch's spell as this.
The brave mouse with a sword who sails to the end of the world.
The talking horse who carries Shasta.
The faun Lucy meets at the lamppost.
The couple who hide the children in their dam and give them dinner.
clues.a: Who are Mr and Mrs Beaver?

clues.q: The owl who takes Jill and Eustace to a midnight parliament.
Lucy first gets in through this piece of furniture.
In Prince Caspian, the children are pulled into Narnia while waiting at one of these.
In The Voyage of the Dawn Treader, Edmund, Lucy and Eustace fall into one of these hanging on the wall.
clues.a: What is a painting (of a ship)?

clues.q: Digory and Polly use these, coloured yellow and green, to travel between worlds.
The wood full of pools that Digory and Polly pass through between worlds.
clues.a: What is the Wood between the Worlds?

clues.q: She makes it always winter and never Christmas.
Caspian's wicked uncle, who seized the throne.
The ape who dresses a donkey in a lion skin.
The Calormene prince who is turned into a donkey.
The White Witch's real name.
Eustace turns into a dragon here.
Slave traders capture Caspian and his friends here.
Lucy reads the magician's book on this island.
clues.a: What is the Island of the Voices?

clues.q: A pool here turns anything into gold.
Three lost lords lie asleep at Aslan's Table on this island, home of a retired star.
The sweet the White Witch gives Edmund.
Mr Beaver catches these through a hole in the ice for dinner.
Digory brings home one of these, silver in colour, to heal his mother.
At Harfang, Jill and Eustace discover they are meant to be the main ingredient in this.
Planted in Narnia's new soil, this sweet grows into a tree.
The gloomy Marsh-wiggle who guides Jill and Eustace.
The lost prince, son of Caspian.
The castle of the gentle giants, who aren't so gentle.
The underground kingdom ruled by the Lady of the Green Kirtle.
The deeper land below Underland where the gnomes come from.
Shasta's real name.
The talking mare who carries Aravis.
The capital city of Calormen.
The old Tarkaan Aravis is supposed to marry.
The Narnians' ship they escape Tashbaan on.
Told the children that Aslan isn't safe, but he is good.
Told the witch he'd go on living like a Narnian even if there were no Narnia.
At the Stone Table, claimed Edmund's life under the Deep Magic.
Told Lucy and Edmund that he is known by another name in their world.
Wondered aloud what they teach children in schools these days, since nobody seems to learn logic.
Aslan is this kind of animal.
Where Aslan dies in place of Edmund.
Aslan's father.
At the end of the world in the Dawn Treader, Aslan first appears as this animal.
Aslan creates Narnia by doing this.
Digory's uncle, who makes the magic rings.
The magician who rules the Dufflepuds.
In Prince Caspian, Nikabrik brings a hag and one of these to the council.
The Lady of the Green Kirtle turns into this.
Uncle Andrew's godmother, who left him a box of dust from Atlantis.
The castle where the Pevensies are crowned.
The country just south of Narnia, ruled by King Lune.
The ancient mound built over the Stone Table.
The river crossing where Aslan's army goes in Prince Caspian, at the Fords of this place.
The wild woodland where the lamppost stands.

final.clue: The White Witch knew the Deep Magic, but she didn't know about this, which brought Aslan back to life.
final.answer: What is the Deeper Magic from before the dawn of time?
